elements.requirement: Statutory interest in relation to a qualifying debt is subject to remission where, by reason of any conduct of the supplier, the interests of justice require that it should be remitted in whole or part in respect of a period for which it would otherwise run.
elements.quote: by reason of any conduct of the supplier, the interests of justice require that statutory interest should be remitted in whole or part in respect of a period for which it would otherwise run in relation to a qualifying debt

elements.requirement: Statutory interest shall not run for a period if the interests of justice require that the supplier should receive no statutory interest for that period.
elements.quote: If the interests of justice require that the supplier should receive no statutory interest for a period, statutory interest shall not run for that period

elements.requirement: Statutory interest shall run at such rate as meets the justice of the case for a period if the interests of justice require that the supplier should receive statutory interest at a reduced rate for that period.
elements.quote: If the interests of justice require that the supplier should receive statutory interest at a reduced rate for a period, statutory interest shall run at such rate as meets the justice of the case for that period

elements.requirement: Remission of statutory interest may be required by reason of the supplier's conduct occurring at any time, whether before or after the time at which the debt is created.
elements.quote: Remission of statutory interest under this section may be required— (a) by reason of conduct at any time (whether before or after the time at which the debt is created)

elements.requirement: Remission of statutory interest may be required for the entire period for which statutory interest would otherwise run or for one or more parts of that period.
elements.quote: for the whole period for which statutory interest would otherwise run or for one or more parts of that period

elements.requirement: The conduct of the supplier taken into account includes any act or omission.

thresholds.what: number of parts of the period for which remission of statutory interest may be required
thresholds.quote: for one or more parts of that period
